text:
morgan: FYI vendor-jp flagged a partial recall/thermal sensor drift on H100 batch 23-47. 12 units at FRA depot 3. Need procurement + ops decision: return-to-vendor (R2V) vs depot repair.
jess: Do we have AWB/manifest and photos? Will this hit our EU provision windows?
vendor-jp: Manifest + photos in secure link. Summary:
```
AWB: 4876123490
PO: RW-2024-1456
SKU: H100-48GB
Units flagged: 12
Current: FRA-DEPOT-3 (arrived)
Issue: thermal sensor drift detected in QC
```
Options: R2V (vendor handles replacement, you pay outbound courier & admin) or depot repair (local bench, ~3-5d).
diego: Cost quick take: R2V courier ~€1,200 + customs admin ~€150. Depot bench fee ~€220/unit + handling. Need vendor repair success rate to decide.
vendor-jp: Historical depot repair pass rate ~85% for this fault. Parts covered under warranty when fail.
zhen: Operational note: FRA dock slots are tight next week. If depot repair we must confirm dock slot by EOD tomorrow or risk +48h. AMS crossdock also limited. Prefer minimal cross-border moves.
ops-bot: [shipment-4876123490] ARRIVED FRA-DEPOT-3 2024-11-02 07:18 UTC. Photos uploaded by depot.
samir: Finance draft:
- R2V: direct cost to Redwood = courier €1,200 + admin €150 = €1,350 (vendor covers replacements).
- Depot repair: bench €220 * 12 = €2,640 + handling €300 = €2,940. But vendor says parts covered; if we get bench fee waiver for some units, depot could be cheaper.
morgan: Procurement note: list price ~€26k/unit, but warranty replacement credit applies. Vendor — can you waive bench fee for warranty batch? Also provide formal replacement cost if warranty denied.
vendor-jp: We can waive bench fee for up to 8 units as a one-time concession. Replacement under warranty = no charge for confirmed failures. Will send PO amendment and signed note to procurement@redwood.internal within 90 minutes.
diego: With 8 waived bench fees, depot cost = 4*220 + handling 300 = €1,180. Even if repairs fully pass, depot avoids cross-border courier and is cheaper on expected value.
zhen: I can hold FRA dock until 18:00 CET today. If we get written waiver, we proceed depot. If not, we fallback to R2V and need procurement courier signoff.
morgan: @vendor-jp please send written waiver and PO amendment referencing RW-2024-1456.
ops-bot: Reminder to morgan: dock hold expires 2024-11-02 18:00 UTC unless confirmed.
samir: Finance will post a 2-scenario expected-cost calc by 17:30 CET.
jess: Also capture serials now — depot repair needs serial trace for warranty logs. vendor-jp: serials delivered via secure share (link redacted).
morgan: Tentative plan = depot repair pending written waiver. Will update once amendment arrives. :thumbsup:
